triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in `area:build` · `domain:spec` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:queue` · size S. Grade raised p3 → p2. Type set to Bug.
Rationale: the Studio hook designer offers the `refusals` and `texts` rows on an expression-body hook, and filling either makes the save refuse. That is an experience problem in authoring, and under North Star Priority rule 2 the UX rule applies in any area: UX has no p3. As severity × reach it is also Impeded × builders, often ⇒ p2. The fix is two `visibleWhen` predicates plus a pin in `packages/spec`, as the card asks.

- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.metadata-form.ts` (renamed from `hook.form.ts` since filing): one `visibleWhen` on the `refusals` row and on the `texts` row, both carrying the schema's own test as `{dialect:'cel', source:"data.body.language == 'js' || data.body == null && data.handler != null && data.handler != ''"}`, written without parentheses because the Studio evaluator fails open on them (out-of-scope finding A).
- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-declared-rows.pin.test.ts`: a new top-level describe that reads both predicates and lines them up with `HookSchema.safeParse` issue paths on five cases. Ablation: removing either `visibleWhen` turns the pin red.
- One `.changeset/*.md` (`@objectstack/spec` patch).
NOT any other file: no `hook.zod.ts`, no evaluator, no other `*.metadata-form.ts`. Stop on breach and explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:thread`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates.mjs --tier: "no path-derived mandate"`, `effort: high`, reason: the thread session serves effort high
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: on a hook whose body is an expression, the Studio hook editor no longer offers `refusals` or `texts`. It still offers both for a `js` body, and for no body with a handler. The two predicates agree with `hook.zod.ts`'s refinements (l.313 / l.360) on all five measured cases. The accepted set of the schema does not change, so the form only stops offering rows the schema already refuses.
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds, measured on origin/main 815e882b. `hook.metadata-form.ts` has 0 `visibleWhen`, and its `refusals` (l.58) and `texts` (l.82) rows are ungated. The schema's tests are unchanged. #36725 is closed, so the Studio host does draw these rows. Full report: `/mnt/project-files/card-36799/pre-claim-report-815e882b.md`.
Serial constraints cleared: `none — no open PR touches these files and no issue-36799 branch exists`
Out of scope, report only: (A) parenthesised predicates fail open in the Studio evaluator, measured on 815e882b: `field.metadata-form.ts` `percentDisplay` (l.102) and the currency row (l.120) evaluate true on type `text`, and false without the parentheses. The seat files it. (B) A hidden row keeps any value already filled in; this goes in the acceptance notes only.

Claim amendment (file surface) for PR #38078: Test Core 6/10 was red because of this PR.
Added to the file surface: `packages/lint/src/validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts`. Its "#7010 corpus — shipped METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY" case pins the shipped predicate count (96 → 98) and the single-quoted `==`/`!=` comparison count (67 → 71). The two hook predicates add one predicate each, with two comparisons each. Only those two counts and their history comment change. The validator accepts the new predicates.
Note: `dispatch-gates` did not derive `@objectstack/lint`'s test from a `packages/spec` `*.metadata-form.ts` edit. That derivation gap is reported, not fixed here.
Clause-② no, Metadata-protocol none and the patch level are unchanged.
